column1: # gemdos-mc-fs20.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, GEMDOS meets a media change (TASK/TOOL20):
# the cases of the probe tosdump/probes/gcprobe.c (TASK/FS20) as a case
# table, against EmuTOS 1a7484ab (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md).
# EmuTOS, read from the source (docs/api/gemdos/_state.md section 4a): a
# logical write of sector 0 arms forcechange (bios/blkdev.c:450-453,
# 473-477); the next GEMDOS access to the drive meets it -- getbcb's Mediach
# on a buffer hit (bdos/fsbuf.c:179-190) or E_CHNG from the Rwabs of a miss
# (bdos/fs.h:60-68) -- and osif logs the drive in again with the NEW boot
# sector and restarts the call (bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487); that Getbpb clears
# forcechange (bios/blkdev.c:589-590).
# WHERE IT RUNS: the oracle's profile disk (HATARI_ORACLE_DISK=<test.img>
# tools/hatari-oracle.sh disk DUMPBIOS.PRG <table> <out>) and NewTOS through
# cargo xtask tosdump bios <table> --testdisk <test.img>.  The test image is
# the one of the three gemdos-mc tables: tools/mktestdisk.sh with
# C:\NEWDESK.INF (#Z autorun of D:\DUMPBIOS.NAP), C:\PXPROBE.PRG,
# C:\PXPROBE.NAP, C:\DELME.TXT and C:\SUB\INNER.TXT
# (measurements/measurement-2026-10-29-tool20/RUNINFO.TXT).
# DESTRUCTIVE ("!disk 2 destructive"; docs/TOS-REFERENCE-DUMPER.md section
# 6, "The closing tables" and "GEMDOS after a media change"): part B leaves
# a changed boot sector (512 -> 256 root entries) and a new file
# C:\GCPROBE.DAT behind.  It runs on a fresh clone of the test image only;
# both sides must end in the same test partition (root-directory time stamps
# zeroed: each side stamps the new file with its own clock).
#   Fcreate opens the file, t:1 is its handle, Fclose(t:1) closes it.  The
#   512 bytes Fwrite writes are buffer 0 as the poison left it (DE AD ...):
#   where they land in the image shows the geometry of the write (gcprobe's
#   marker; EmuTOS: the file's first cluster in the new geometry).
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!disk
# ---- part A: re-login after the handshake, the boot sector unchanged

column5: A01 Dfree(C:): logs C: in, the image's geometry -- bdos/fsfat.c:337
A03 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
A04 write it back unchanged, RW_NOMEDIACH: arms forcechange -- bios/blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
A06 Dfree(C:) meets the change: re-login, restart -- bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487
A07 Mediach(2): 0, the re-login's Getbpb cleared it -- bios/blkdev.c:589-590
A08 Getbpb(2): the image's BPB -- bios/blkdev.c:569-777

column1: # ---- part B: the boot sector changed, root entries 512 -> 256

column5: B01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)

column1: +set

column5: B02 write the changed boot sector, RW_NOMEDIACH: arms -- bios/blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
B04 Dfree(C:): the geometry GEMDOS uses now (total 32676) -- bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487
B07 Getbpb(2): the changed BPB -- bios/blkdev.c:569-777
